title: horizon and show of the review story list every unconfirmed provisional answer, not only held ones
goal: backlog.py show of a sprint's review story and horizon --sprint SP list every provisional answer an agent gave that the operator has not confirmed, held or not, so the review brief and the operator's confirmation see all of them before the review's done; kb/_self/tools.md names it as every unconfirmed provisional answer

run:
import sys, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, shutil
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_base
r = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = r / bl_base.rel_dir(); d.mkdir(parents=True)
shutil.copy("backlog.json", r / "backlog.json")
def put(it): (d / (it["id"] + ".json")).write_text(bl_base.canonical(it), encoding="utf-8")
put({"id": "SP-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "sprint", "title": "s", "goal": "g one", "status": "active", "gates": [{"id": "start", "kind": "blocking", "question": "q", "options": ["approve"], "recommendation": "approve", "answer": "approve", "by": "operator"}]})
gate = {"id": "g1", "kind": "provisional", "question": "which", "options": ["alpha", "beta"], "recommendation": "alpha", "answer": "alpha", "by": "agent"}
put({"id": "BG-bbbbbbbb", "kind": "bug", "title": "t", "goal": "g", "status": "done", "sprint": "SP-aaaaaaaa", "gates": [gate]})
put({"id": "ST-dddddddd", "kind": "story", "title": "review", "goal": "g", "status": "todo", "sprint": "SP-aaaaaaaa", "review": True, "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}]})
def run(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "--root", str(r), *a], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
shown, hz = run("show", "ST-dddddddd"), run("horizon", "--sprint", "SP-aaaaaaaa")
ok = "alpha" in shown and "alpha" in hz and "BG-bbbbbbbb" in shown and "BG-bbbbbbbb" in hz
print("both list the unheld provisional answer" if ok else "unheld provisional answer missing: show=%s horizon=%s" % ("alpha" in shown, "alpha" in hz))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/tools.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').lower()
miss=[w for w in ['every unconfirmed provisional answer'] if w not in t]
sys.exit('not yet: kb/_self/tools.md lacks '+', '.join(miss) if miss else 0)
